title: A LATE TEAMMATE IS CHARGED FOR THE TIME HE PLAYED
why: A teammate who joins a raid in progress takes the host clock, so his raid time counted the minutes before he came up: an abandon 10 seconds after joining 20 minutes in cost him about 220 XP instead of about 100, and his run read 20 minutes long. His run length and the abandon XP cost now count from when he joined. A player who started the raid is charged exactly as before.
now: JOIN THE RAID IN PROGRESS: the abandon XP cost and the run length count from when you joined, not from when your host went up.
